raw.details:
The system is under attack. Logic is your weapon. Algorithms are your ammunition. Only the fastest minds will survive.

Welcome to CODE RED, the ultimate Competitive Programming Contest at XORDIUM 5.0, the technical fest of Birla Institute of Technology (BIT), Mesra, Patna Campus. Step into a cyberpunk-inspired digital battleground where every second counts, every submission matters, and every bug could cost you the leaderboard.

Gear up to decode complex problems, optimize your algorithms, and outsmart competing coders in a high-intensity battle of logic, speed, and precision. The countdown is ticking. The terminal is live. Will you rise above the chaos?

ENTER THE GRID. BREAK THE CODE. DOMINATE THE SYSTEM.

All That You Need to Know About CODE RED

CODE RED is a competitive programming contest designed to challenge participants' algorithmic thinking, data structures knowledge, coding speed, and problem-solving abilities. Hosted as part of XORDIUM 5.0 at BIT Mesra, Patna Campus, the contest welcomes passionate programmers ready to test their skills against talented coders.

Whether you're a seasoned competitive programmer or an aspiring algorithmic problem-solver, this is your chance to enter the arena and prove your coding prowess.

Contest Details

  • Event Name: CODE RED — Competitive Programming Contest
  • Fest: XORDIUM 5.0
  • Organized By: Birla Institute of Technology (BIT), Mesra, Patna Campus
  • Event Type: Competitive Programming
  • Participation: Individual
  • Mode: Online
  • Platform: Unstop
  • Duration: 1.5 Hours
  • Date & Time: 25 Oct 2026 7:30PM to 11:30 PM
  • Registration Deadline: 24 oct 2026

Eligibility

The contest is open to students passionate about programming and problem-solving.

  • Undergraduate Students
  • Postgraduate Students
  • Engineering and Technology Students
  • Students from Management, Science, Commerce, Arts, Law, and other disciplines

Individual participation only. No teams. No shortcuts. Just you, your code, and the clock.

Rules & Regulations

  • The contest will feature algorithmic and data-structure-based programming problems.
  • Participants must solve and submit their solutions within the allotted contest duration.
  • Participants must register through Unstop and follow the official contest instructions.
  • Plagiarism, copied submissions, or the use of multiple accounts to gain an unfair advantage may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must comply with the contest platform's rules and the organizers' instructions.
  • Rankings will be determined using the contest platform's scoring and tie-breaking rules.
  • The organizing team's decision regarding contest administration and disputes will be final.

Process & Format

  • Step 1 — Register: Sign up for CODE RED through Unstop.
  • Step 2 — Gear Up: Review the contest guidelines and ensure your coding environment is ready.
  • Step 3 — Enter the Grid: Join the online contest during the officially announced time window.
  • Step 4 — Solve & Survive: Tackle algorithmic challenges, submit optimized solutions, and climb the leaderboard.
  • Step 5 — Claim Your Glory: Top performers will be recognized according to the officially announced results and prize structure.

Prizes & Recognition

  • Exciting prizes for top-performing participants.
  • Certificates of merit for eligible winners.
  • Participation certificates, subject to the organizers' announced criteria.
  • A chance to showcase your problem-solving skills and competitive programming abilities.

Prize amounts, certificate eligibility, and distribution details will be announced by the organizing team.

Why Participate?

  • Test Your Limits: Challenge your DSA, algorithms, and logical reasoning skills.
  • Race Against Time: Solve problems under pressure and make every submission count.
  • Climb the Leaderboard: Compete with programmers from across institutions.
  • Earn Recognition: Showcase your abilities through your contest performance.
  • Experience the Cyberpunk Arena: Become part of the high-energy technical atmosphere of XORDIUM 5.0.

The Final Transmission

The network is unstable. The countdown has begun. The leaderboard awaits its next champion.

One coder. One terminal. Zero excuses.
